stemex.descriptor: a children's STEM education centre in Norwich offering workshops, Short Breaks and Alternative Provision
stemex.style: bright, optimistic, educational; clean modern illustration or vivid photography of hands-on science; energetic but trustworthy - parents are the buyer, children are the user
variant_angles: close-up of hands doing an experiment
wide shot of a busy workshop table
single hero object (robot, circuit, volcano model) on clean background
parent-and-child moment, faces not identifiable
flat-lay of STEM kit components
stemex.constraints: Children shown from behind or illustrated only, never identifiable faces. No safety hazards visible (goggles on where relevant).

muffin_break.descriptor: a warm, family-friendly bakery cafe in Norwich (Foodco franchise)
muffin_break.style: warm, appetising food photography; natural light, shallow depth of field; cosy cafe atmosphere; convenience and freshness over discounting
variant_angles: hero close-up of the product with steam or texture detail
product in hand at the counter, motion and convenience
flat-lay of coffee plus bake combination
barista handing over order with a smile, face partially out of frame
seasonal tabletop scene
muffin_break.constraints: Food must look real and freshly made, never plastic or oversaturated. Follow franchise brand guidelines for logo use; when in doubt omit the logo.

cafe_ufo.descriptor: a cafe and dark kitchen in Norwich serving wraps, wings and comfort food for delivery and collection
cafe_ufo.style: bold, punchy, street-food energy; high contrast; appetite appeal first; speed and convenience messaging (the 'skip the rush' convenience angle outperforms discounts)
variant_angles: dramatic close-up, sauce pull or crunch moment
boxed order ready for delivery, top-down
neon-lit product hero on dark background
hands grabbing a wrap, urban energy
menu trio lineup
cafe_ufo.constraints: Halal-friendly presentation; no alcohol in frame. Delivery packaging should look branded and tidy.

explorazone.descriptor: an interactive science discovery centre in Bowthorpe, Norwich (rebranded 2026, formerly Exploring Sciences)
explorazone.style: wonder and discovery; vivid colour, dramatic lighting on exhibits; family day-out energy; big visual scale contrast (small child, big exhibit)
variant_angles: child silhouette dwarfed by a glowing exhibit
close-up of hands on an interactive exhibit
family group from behind, immersed in an exhibit hall
single spectacular exhibit as hero on dark background
ticket-offer graphic with exhibit photo background
explorazone.constraints: Brand name is exactly 'Explorazone' - one word, capital E - never 'Exploring Sciences', 'Science Museum' or any other variant. Children from behind or illustrated only.
